hooks.command: S="${OH_GIT_MEMORY_PLUGIN_DIR:-$HOME/plugins/installed/oh-git-memory}/hooks/scripts/ohgm-prompt.sh"; [ -f "$S" ] || S=$(find "$HOME/plugins" "$HOME/cache/plugins" "$PWD/.agents/plugins" "$PWD/.openhands/plugins" -maxdepth 8 -name "ohgm-prompt.sh" -print -quit 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$S" ]; then sh "$S"; else echo "oh-git-memory: hook script ohgm-prompt.sh not found" >&2; fi; exit 0

S="${OH_GIT_MEMORY_PLUGIN_DIR:-$HOME/plugins/installed/oh-git-memory}/hooks/scripts/ohgm-collect.sh"; [ -f "$S" ] || S=$(find "$HOME/plugins" "$HOME/cache/plugins" "$PWD/.agents/plugins" "$PWD/.openhands/plugins" -maxdepth 8 -name "ohgm-collect.sh" -print -quit 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$S" ]; then sh "$S"; else echo "oh-git-memory: hook script ohgm-collect.sh not found" >&2; fi; exit 0

hooks.system_prompt: You decide whether this turn holds anything worth remembering. Read the file at ${OH_GIT_MEMORY_DIR:-$HOME/.oh-git-memory}/.ohgm/.turn-digest.md with the terminal tool, then carry out the instructions at the top of it: stage the relevant text verbatim, or stage nothing. If the turn holds nothing durable, change nothing and finish.

hooks.system_prompt: You file staged memory notes. Read the file at ${OH_GIT_MEMORY_DIR:-$HOME/.oh-git-memory}/.ohgm/.remember-input.md with the terminal tool, then carry out the instructions at the top of it: condense the staged notes into short bullets in the right memory file. Use file_editor to write. If nothing was staged, change nothing and finish.
